data.title: Mindfulness Journal
data.metaDescription: A mindfulness journal setup—soft prompts, low-spoon entries, and gentle structure to keep awareness kind.
data.heroImagePrompt: Open mindfulness journal with pen, tea, and candle on a wooden table, morning light coming in.
altTexts: Open mindfulness journal with pen and tea in morning light.
Candle and mug beside a small notebook on a wooden table.
Hands writing in a soft-lit mindfulness journal.

internalLinkHints.rationale: Keep all notes in one place to spot patterns.
Use one-line entries when spoons are scarce.
Pair with broader journaling tips for flow.
Let focus stay soft as you write.
Close each entry with a quick gratitude spark.
